  WHERE ((e.module_id = pro_reviews.module_id) AND (e.user_id = pro_reviews.user_id) AND (e.practitioner_id = auth.uid()) AND (e.status = 'active'::text) AND COALESCE(((((m.published_content -> 'feedback'::text) -> 'weekly'::text) ->> 'sync_to_practitioner'::text))::boolean, false))))));
